subject: reasoning
question:
Select the numbers that can replace the question marks (?) in the following series.

22, 25, 19, 28, 16, 31, ?, ?
solution:
The pattern followed is, 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac3021bd48441f4650ae07d15f3ce9b3cde8989606279b59fecfa0fadaa36bd0.png] 

The series pattern is both increasing and decreasing multiple of 3.

Hence, 13, 34 is the correct answer.
